meta.description: Automotive Supply Chain Intelligence Platform — Connected relational database

oems.name: Toyota Motor Corporation
oems.notes: World's largest automaker by volume. TNGA platform shared across Corolla, Camry, RAV4.

products.name: High-Voltage Battery Pack
products.notes: 800V architecture. NCM 811 or LFP cell chemistry.

products.name: Door Seal System
products.design_standard: OEM NVH spec / IP67 door seal

products.name: CFRP Hood Panel
products.notes: Lightweight alternative to steel/Al for performance vehicles.

products.name: Tyre (passenger car)
products.notes: Steel belt + carcass cords. Natural + synthetic rubber compound tread.

products.name: Rear Subframe Assembly
products.notes: Welded steel + Al castings. Critical safety item.

products.name: Long-Fibre Thermoplastic (LFT) Door Module
products.notes: PP+GF40 LFT compression moulded. Replaces stamped steel door inner.

products.name: HUD Glass (Head-Up Display)
products.notes: Wedge-shaped laminated glass with specific PVB for HUD image projection.

materials.name: PP+EPDM-TD20 (Bumper Grade)
materials.notes: Talc-filled PP with EPDM rubber modifier. Paintable. Cold-impact resistant to -40°C.

materials.name: PHS 1500 / 22MnB5 (Hot Stamp Steel)
materials.notes: AlSi coating prevents oxidation during austenitisation at 900°C.

materials.name: PP+GF40 LFT (Long-Fibre Thermoplastic)
materials.notes: Injection or compression mouldable. 3-5× stiffer than standard PP. Replaces stamped metal in semi-structural apps.

materials.name: PVB Wedge Film (HUD Grade)
materials.notes: Wedge angle 0.3–0.7 mrad for HUD double-image suppression.

processes.name: Injection Molding
processes.notes: High-volume, tight tolerances. All-electric preferred for energy efficiency.

processes.name: High-Pressure Die Casting
processes.notes: Mega-casting (Tesla Giga Press 9000T) extends to large structural parts.

processes.name: Hot Stamping (Press Hardening)
processes.notes: Boron steel austenitised at 900°C, formed and water-quenched in die. Achieves 1500 MPa.

processes.name: Reaction Injection Molding
processes.notes: Two-component PU. Used for large IP skins and soft-touch surfaces.

processes.name: Wire EDM
processes.notes: Used for precision tooling, die inserts. Surface Ra 0.1 μm achievable.

processes.name: LFT Direct Compression Moulding
processes.notes: Long-fibre thermoplastic direct process: inline compounding → press. Near-net-shape, short cycle.

processes.name: PCB Assembly (SMT + THT)
processes.notes: Surface mount technology. AOI inspection mandatory. IATF 16949 + AEC-Q100 qualification.

processes.name: Wiring Harness Assembly
processes.notes: Labour-intensive. Mainly manual with automated cutting/crimping. Moving to low-cost regions.

equipment.name: High-Pressure Die Casting Machine
equipment.notes: Tesla Giga Press 9000T for rear + front underbody mega-castings.

equipment.name: Hot Runner System (Mould)
equipment.notes: Eliminates runner waste. Critical for automotive A-surface parts. Valve-gate versions for optical parts.

equipment.name: Temperature Control Unit (TCU / Mould Tempering)
equipment.notes: Critical for part quality and cycle time. Multi-zone control. Water 10–90°C, oil to 180°C.

equipment.name: Plastic Dryer / Dehumidifier
equipment.notes: Required for hygroscopic resins (PA6, PA66, PBT, PC, ABS). Target dew point -30°C.

equipment.name: Gripper / End-of-Arm Tool (EOAT)
equipment.notes: Vacuum cups (Piab), parallel grippers (Schunk), magnetic grippers. Custom-designed per part geometry.

equipment.name: Pallet Automation / FMS (CNC)
equipment.notes: Enables unattended 24/7 operation. Essential for automotive tooling production.

equipment.name: Vacuum Degassing Unit (HPDC)
equipment.notes: Critical for structural castings requiring T6 heat treatment. Reduces porosity <1%.

equipment.name: Shot Sleeve / Dosing Furnace
applications: Al melt dosing to HPDC shot sleeve

equipment_suppliers.name: Sumitomo (SHI) Demag Plastics Machinery
equipment_suppliers.notes: ~95% all-electric fleet. Formed from SHI + Demag Ergotech 2008 merger.

equipment_suppliers.name: Engel Austria GmbH
equipment_suppliers.notes: Family-owned. duo 12000 (12,365T) = world's largest IMM. FY2024/25 €1.5B.

equipment_suppliers.name: Fanuc Corporation
equipment_suppliers.notes: CNC systems power >60% of world's CNC machines.

equipment_suppliers.name: Makino Milling Machine Co., Ltd.
equipment_suppliers.notes: Nidec hostile takeover bid withdrawn May 2025.

equipment_suppliers.name: Sodick Co., Ltd.
equipment_suppliers.notes: World #1 EDM market share. Linear motor drive technology. Acquired Prima Additive May 2025.

equipment_suppliers.name: Bühler AG / Idra Group
equipment_suppliers.notes: Bühler Carat series 420–920T, Idra OL-9000 for Giga Press class.

equipment_suppliers.name: KUKA AG
equipment_suppliers.notes: Owned by Midea Group China. €43.5M net loss FY2024.

equipment_suppliers.name: Universal Robots A/S
equipment_suppliers.notes: World #1 cobot brand >40% market share. Teradyne subsidiary. First overseas plant Nantong CN Dec 2024.

equipment_suppliers.name: Beckhoff Automation GmbH & Co. KG
equipment_suppliers.notes: EtherCAT inventor. Revenue -33% in 2024 to €1.17B due to inventory de-stocking.

equipment_suppliers.name: Keyence Corporation
equipment_suppliers.notes: $88B market cap. >80% gross margin. Direct sales model. No debt.

equipment_suppliers.name: HASCO / Husky / Mold-Masters (Hillenbrand)
equipment_suppliers.notes: Hot runner manifolds, valve gates, nozzles. Husky = world's largest hot runner supplier for PET. Mold-Masters acquired by Hillenbrand 2012.

equipment_suppliers.name: Regloplas / HB-Therm / Single Temperiertechnik
equipment_suppliers.notes: Precision mould temperature control. Water circuits 10–90°C, oil up to 180°C. Multi-zone control for complex moulds.

equipment_suppliers.name: Frigel / Piovan Aquatech / Advantage Engineering
equipment_suppliers.notes: Process chillers for IMM cooling, die casting cooling, clean rooms.

equipment_suppliers.name: Piovan Group / Moretto / Novatec
equipment_suppliers.notes: Piovan world's largest plastics auxiliary supplier. OTX drying technology. Gravimetric blenders. Vacuum conveying systems.

equipment_suppliers.name: Sepro Group / Star Automation / Beck Automation
equipment_suppliers.notes: Sepro specialises in 3-axis and 5-axis cartesian robots for IMM part removal. Star Automation dominant in Japan.

equipment_suppliers.name: Schunk GmbH / Zimmer Group / Piab
equipment_suppliers.notes: Schunk world's #1 gripping technology. Pneumatic, electric, magnetic grippers. Piab vacuum cups. Zimmer linear guides.

equipment_suppliers.name: Hytrol Conveyor / Dorner / Knapp
equipment_suppliers.notes: Belt conveyors, accumulation conveyors, cool-down tunnels for IMM and press lines.

equipment_suppliers.name: Bosch Rexroth Weldtech / ARO / Obara
equipment_suppliers.notes: Servo spot welding controllers. ARO pneumatic guns. Obara guns for Japanese OEM lines.

equipment_suppliers.name: Erowa AG / System 3R / Fastems
equipment_suppliers.notes: Erowa tooling pallet systems world #1. Fastems FMS for multi-machine CNC automation. System 3R (Sandvik) electrode holders for EDM.

equipment_suppliers.name: Zeiss Industrial Metrology / Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence
equipment_suppliers.notes: Zeiss Contura / PRISMO CMMs. Hexagon Global / GLOBAL S series. World's two largest metrology suppliers.

equipment_suppliers.name: StrikoWestofen / Fondarex / Bühler Die Casting
equipment_suppliers.notes: StrikoWestofen melting/holding furnaces. Fondarex vacuum systems for die casting. Bühler complete HPDC cell solutions.

equipment_suppliers.name: ATI Industrial Automation / Kistler Group
equipment_suppliers.notes: ATI multi-axis F/T sensors and tool changers for robots. Kistler piezoelectric sensors for press and injection monitoring.

equipment_suppliers.name: SICK AG / Pilz GmbH / Schmersal
equipment_suppliers.notes: SICK safety scanners and light curtains. Pilz safety controllers (PNOZ). Schmersal safety switches. IEC 62061 / ISO 13849 compliant.

equipment_suppliers.name: ATEQ / Cosmo Instruments / Cincinnati Test Systems
equipment_suppliers.notes: ATEQ world's leading leak tester. Pressure decay and mass flow methods for automotive fluid components.

equipment_suppliers.name: Branson Ultrasonics (Emerson) / Herrmann Ultraschall
equipment_suppliers.notes: Branson world #1 ultrasonic welding for plastics. Used in ECU housings, fluid reservoirs, filters.

equipment_suppliers.name: Despatch Industries / Grieve Corporation / Heatcon
equipment_suppliers.notes: Industrial ovens for paint baking, adhesive curing, CFRP autoclave post-cure, battery module formation.

equipment_suppliers.name: Nordson Corporation / Graco Inc.
equipment_suppliers.notes: Nordson adhesive dispensing + inspection. Graco fluid handling. Used for PU sealants, battery TIM, FIPG sealing.

equipment_suppliers.name: Atlas Copco Tools / Desoutter Industrial
equipment_suppliers.notes: Servo-controlled torque-angle fastening. Traceability per ISO/TS 16949. Battery assembly, dashboard, powertrain.

equipment_suppliers.name: Larsen & Toubro Machinery / HF Mixing Group (tyre)
equipment_suppliers.notes: HF (Herbert Frank) tyre curing presses. L&T machinery for Indian tyre manufacturers.

equipment_suppliers.name: Fuji Machine Mfg. / Panasonic Connect / Yamaha Motor
equipment_suppliers.notes: High-speed SMT placement for automotive ECUs and ADAS modules.

manufacturers.name: CATL (Contemporary Amperex Technology)
manufacturers.notes: World's largest EV battery maker. 2025 global market share ~37%.

manufacturers.name: Bridgestone Corporation
manufacturers.notes: World's largest tyre maker. Run-flat DriveGuard for BMW. Turanza EV specific for EV makers.

manufacturers.name: Sumitomo Electric Industries / Yazaki
manufacturers.notes: Yazaki world's #1 wiring harness. Sumitomo Wiring Systems leading in Europe.

manufacturers.name: Robert Bosch GmbH (Powertrain Solutions)
manufacturers.notes: World's largest automotive supplier. Precision machined fuel injectors require CNC + EDM tooling.

raw_material_suppliers.name: SABIC / LyondellBasell
raw_material_suppliers.notes: World-leading automotive polymer compounds. SABIC STAMAX long-fibre PP.

raw_material_suppliers.name: Covestro / LANXESS
raw_material_suppliers.notes: Covestro Makrolon PC. LANXESS Durethan PA66.

raw_material_suppliers.name: ArcelorMittal
raw_material_suppliers.notes: Usibor and Ductibor AlSi-coated PHS grades for hot stamping.

raw_material_suppliers.name: Toray / Hexcel Corporation
raw_material_suppliers.notes: Toray T300/T700/T800 carbon tow. Hexcel HexPly prepreg systems.

raw_material_suppliers.name: Von Bundit / RRIM Malaysia / Michelin Natural Rubber
raw_material_suppliers.notes: Natural rubber from Hevea plantations. Von Bundit Thailand. RRIM = Rubber Research Institute Malaysia.

raw_material_suppliers.name: Celanese / Lanxess Tepex / SABIC LFT
raw_material_suppliers.notes: Celanese Hostaform POM. LANXESS Tepex LFT continuous fibre. SABIC STAMAX LFT PP for structural automotive.

raw_material_suppliers.name: Isola Group / Shengyi Technology
raw_material_suppliers.notes: FR4 laminates for automotive electronics. AEC-Q qualification for high-temp automotive grades.

raw_material_suppliers.name: Nexans / Prysmian Automotive / Leoni
raw_material_suppliers.notes: Copper wire drawing for wiring harnesses. HV cables for EV (up to 800V / 1000A). Al wire alternative for weight saving.

design_engineers.name: IAV Automotive Engineering
design_engineers.notes: Jointly owned by Volkswagen and Audi.
